# Three.js runtime

Version: 0.180.0 (npm package `three`). License: MIT; see LICENSE.

The upstream production modules are copied without modifications from
`three/build/three.module.min.js` and `three/build/three.core.min.js`.
They are hosted with the site so the homepage does not need an external CDN.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
